Can Archon enter combat with minion protected by Secure Haven?

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
> Can Archon enter combat with minion protected by Secure Haven?

No. The action the Archon takes to enter into combat with a minion
is a (D)irected action. Secure Haven prevents (D)irected actions from
being taken against the minion SH is on.

Sorrow

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct. The only way an Archon could enter combat with the Secured vampire
is if one blocked the other (or the Secured Vamp rushed the Archon).
